subject.title: TABIND Scrabble Project & GitHub Profile Update
details: TABIND Scrabble Project (https://github.com/RossJiao/scrabble-project): Developed a Python program that finds all valid Scrabble words from the letters 'tabind'. Switched to official SOWPODS Scrabble dictionary (178,691 words), finding 49 legitimate Scrabble words.
GitHub Profile Update (https://github.com/RossJiao): Created profile README with personal introduction and project table. All repositories now have detailed README files.
MIT 6.0001 Python Lectures: Completed Lectures 1 through 11.

notes: The SOWPODS dictionary is the official international Scrabble word list used in competitions outside North America.
Switching to the Scrabble dictionary improved result accuracy — the previous system dictionary included many non-Scrabble words.
GitHub profile now matches the organization standards discussed in team meetings.
